features.rationale: Solid shaft with both reduced necks and unequal end collars; axial stations preserve all printed length dimensions.
Cut the longitudinal external keyway toward +X from its floor, centered about y=0. Continuous longitudinal edges indicate an end-to-end cut, naturally interrupted by both smaller necks.
What exact radius is required at the four neck roots? The specified maximum does not define a unique radius.
Does C/R require a radius or allow a chamfer? Resolve the treatment before applying it to the outside end edges.

notes: Tie Rod, tool number SB11780, model 120 ME. Full sheet specifies dimensions in inches and material 1018; CFS is marked at the stock surface.
Origin is the left end-face center; +Z points toward the right end. The front-view keyway opens toward +X and is centered about y=0.
Use nominal D001 reference stock diameter for the model. D008 controls keyway floor position from the opposite outside tangent; do not substitute an independently specified radial depth.
Right collar width is D002 - D004 - D003 (D014); central body length is D003 - 2 * D005 (D015). Do not force equal collar widths.
Full-sheet title block gives two-place dimensions ±.02, three-place dimensions ±.010, and angular dimensions ±1°. These were omitted by the extraction.

Retain geometric tolerances as inspection requirements: left collar inner shoulder perpendicular to A within D011; right collar inner shoulder perpendicular to A within D012 and parallel to B within D013. Datum B is the left collar inner shoulder; confirm datum A attachment before inspection setup.
MACHINE CENTERS PERMITTED allows optional manufacturing centers but does not require dimensioned holes. None are modeled.
The dashed circle in the end view represents the neck diameter, not an axial bore. The broken side view represents a continuous solid shaft, not separate bodies.
Unresolved edge operations are placeholders only; do not apply their listed maximum or provisional radii until clarified.
